write_up: Your resume tells a clear story from account coordination at Hollis Insurance Group to support and then customer success at Brightline Payroll Software. A recruiter can see the accounts you manage and the problems you handle, though some of your work on renewals and escalations needs more detail.

The strongest line is your book of 48 mid-market accounts across healthcare and manufacturing. It gives a recruiter both the number of accounts and the customers you serve. The move from support into customer success is easy to follow, and Experience is in the right place above Education.
